name: Sunderby Kraft
blurb: Customer accounts for a northern power company.
banner: This system is watched at all times. Every connection is traced from the moment it opens.

content.text:
DISCONNECTION ORDERS, WEEK 11

SK-40118  Norrfjärden Health Station  3 months unpaid  Thursday 16 March, 07:00
SK-40377  Storsand Sawmill (closed)   7 months unpaid  Thursday 16 March, 07:00

Note from L. Engström: the health station says the county pays its bill and the county says it has. I cannot find the payment. The order stands until someone shows me one. I do not like it either.

Hardship fund: 30,000 for the winter. Applications: 61. The disconnection orders for week 11 were drawn up before the fund was announced and have not been checked against it. If the Norrfjärden Health Station is on the list, that is a clerical error, and clerical errors are the kind we correct on Monday.

The orders are executed on Saturday.

Substation 6: scheduled outage, 18 March, 02:00 to 05:00. Customers affected: Norrfjärden. All customers notified. The notification letters were printed and are in a tray. The tray is in an office nobody has opened since Tuesday.
